## Import data

Pending

```{r}
# Import the data from the sweep package
bike_sales <- bike_sales |>
    mutate(
        order.id = factor(
            x = order.id,
            ordered = TRUE
        ),
        order.line = factor(
            x = order.line,
            ordered = TRUE
        ),
        customer.id = factor(
            x = customer.id,
            ordered = FALSE
        ),
        product.id = factor(
            x = product.id,
            ordered = FALSE
        )
    )
```

## Relation between continuous variables

Pending

### Price vs quantity

Pending

```{r}
#| label: fig-scatterplot-price-quantity
#| fig-cap: Relationship between price and quantity
cor_price_quantity <- cor(
    x = bike_sales$price,
    y = bike_sales$quantity
)

bike_sales |>
    ggplot() +
    geom_point(
        aes(
            x = price,
            y = quantity,
            color = frame
        )
    ) +
    labs(
        x = "Price (USD Dollars/frame)",
        y = "Quantity (Units)",
        color = "Frame"
    )
```

The correlation is practically zero with the following value: `{r} cor_price_quantity |> format(scientific = FALSE)` 

### Log price vs log quantity

Pending

```{r}
#| label: fig-scatterplot-log-price-log-quantity
#| fig-cap: Relationship between price and quantity using a logarithmic scale
cor_log_price_log_quantity <- cor(
    x = log(bike_sales$price),
    y = log(bike_sales$quantity)
)

bike_sales |>
    ggplot() +
    geom_point(
        aes(
            x = price,
            y = quantity,
            color = frame
        )
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
        transform = "log",
        labels = label_currency(accuracy = 1)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
        transform = "log",
        labels = label_currency(accuracy = 1)
    ) +
    labs(
        x = "Price (USD Dollars/frame - Logarithmic scale)",
        y = "Quantity (Units  - Logarithmic scale)",
        color = "Frame"
    )
```

The correlation is practically zero as in the first case and equal to the value: `{r} cor_log_price_log_quantity |> format(scientific = FALSE)`

## Relation between categorical variables

Pending

```{r}
#| label: fig-relation-frame-cat-2
#| fig-cap: Relationship between frame and category secondary
bike_sales |>
    count(
        frame,

    ) |>
    ggplot() +
```

## Descriptive statistics by group

Pending

### Mean, median and standard deviation for revenue by `(category.secondary, frame)`

Pending

```{r}
#| message: false
#| label: tbl-mean-median-sd-revenue-cat2-frame
#| tbl-cap: Mean, median and standard deviation of revenue by category secondary and frame (US Dollars)
mean_median_sd_revenue_by_cat2_frame <- bike_sales |>
    group_by(
        category.secondary,
        frame
    ) |>
    summarise(
        mean_revenue = mean(price.ext),
        median_revenue = median(price.ext),
        sd_revenue = sd(price.ext)
    ) |>
    ungroup()

mean_median_sd_revenue_by_cat2_frame |>
    datatable(
        colnames = c(
            "Category secondary",
            "Frames",
            "Mean",
            "Median",
            "Standard deviation"
        )
    ) |>
    formatRound(
        columns = c(
            3,
            5
        ),
        digits = 2
    )
```

### Percentage of total revenue generated by `(category.secondary, frame)`

Pending

```{r}
#| message: false
#| label: tbl-pct-revenue-by-cat2-frame
#| tbl-cap: Percentage of revenue generated by category secondary and frame (%)
pct_revenue_by_cat2_frame <- bike_sales |>
    group_by(
        category.secondary,
        frame
    ) |>
    summarise(
        total_revenue = sum(price.ext)
    ) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(
        total_revenue_pct = (total_revenue / sum(total_revenue)) * 100
    ) |>
    arrange(
        desc(total_revenue_pct)
    )

pct_revenue_by_cat2_frame |>
    datatable(
        colnames = c(
            "Category secondary",
            "Frame",
            "Total revenue",
            "Percentage"
        )
    ) |>
    formatRound(
        columns = 4,
        digits = 2
    )
```

## Statistical tests

### Testing group frequencies: `chisq.test()`

Pending

#### Category secondary and frame

Pending

```{r}
#| message: false
#| label: tbl-chisq-test-revenue-by-cat2-frame
#| tbl-cap: Chi-squared test for revenue and given probabilities by category secondary and frame 
table_cat2_frame <- bike_sales |>
    group_by(
        category.secondary,
        frame
    ) |>
    summarise(
        total_revenue = sum(price.ext)
    ) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(
        total_revenue_pct = (total_revenue / sum(total_revenue) * 100)
    ) |>
    arrange(
        desc(total_revenue_pct)
    )

table_models <- table_cat2_frame |>
    mutate(
        model = str_c(
            category.secondary,
            frame,
            sep = " "
        )
    ) |>
    select(
        model,
        total_revenue
    )

deframe_table_models <- table_models |>
    deframe() |>
    chisq.test(
        p = rep.int(x = 1 / 13, times = 13)
    )

deframe_table_models |>
    tidy() |>
    datatable(
        colnames = c(
            "Statistics",
            "P-value",
            "Degrees of freedom",
            "Method"
        )
    ) |>
    formatRound(
        columns = 1,
        digits = 2
    )
```

#### Bike shops

Pending

```{r}
#| label: tbl-chisq-test-revenue-by-bikeshop
#| tbl-cap: Chi-squared test for revenue and given probabilities by bikeshop  
deframe_table_models2 <- bike_sales |>
    group_by(
        bikeshop.name
    ) |>
    summarise(
        total_revenue = sum(price.ext)
    ) |>
    mutate(
        total_revenue_pct = (total_revenue / sum(total_revenue)) * 100
    ) |>
    arrange(
        desc(total_revenue_pct)
    ) |>
    select(
        bikeshop.name,
        total_revenue
    ) |>
    deframe()

deframe_table_models2 |>
    chisq.test(
        p = rep.int(
            x = 1 / 30,
            times = 30
        )
    ) |>
    tidy() |>
    datatable(
        colnames = c(
            "Statistic",
            "P-value",
            "Degrees of freedom",
            "Method"
        )
    ) |>
    formatRound(
        columns = 1,
        digits = 2
    )
```

### Testing group means: `t.test()`

Pending

```{r}
#| label: tbl-t-test-means-two-sided-revenue-by-frame
#| tbl-cap: T-test difference in revenue mean by frame
alpha <- 0.05

bike_sales |>
    t_test(
        formula = price.ext ~ frame,
        alternative = "two-sided",
        order = c("Aluminum", "Carbon"),
        mu = 0,
        conf_level = 1 - alpha
    ) |>
    datatable(
        colnames = c(
            "Statistic",
            "Degrees of freedom",
            "P-value",
            "Method",
            "Estimate",
            "Lower interval value",
            "Upper interval value"
        )
    ) |>
    formatRound(
        columns = c(1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7)
    )
```

### Analysis of Variance (ANOVA)

Pending

- `price ~ category.secondary + frame + category.secondary:frame`

```{r}
model3 <- aov(
    data = bike_sales,
    formula = price ~ category.secondary + frame + category.secondary:frame
) |>
    anova() |>
    tidy()

model3 |>
    datatable(
        colnames = c(
            "Term",
            "Degrees of freedom",
            "Sum of squares",
            "Mean of squares",
            "Statistic",
            "P-value"
        )
    ) |>
    formatRound(
        columns = c(3, 4, 5, 6)
    )
```
